litematlist.config.generic.comment.calcu:
When enabled, items inside containers (chests, barrels, hoppers, shulker boxes, etc.) in the schematic are also counted into the material list
Toggling immediately refreshes the material list (project folders refresh the merged total list)
litematlist.config.generic.comment.syncR:
When enabled, material lists synced from Litematica are re-parsed by the current render layer mode (All / Single Layer / Layer Range / All Below / All Above) whenever the material list is opened
The raw material list updates automatically, and an uploaded list refreshes the upload area immediately
Replacement contents are saved when toggled from OFF to ON, restored when toggled back to OFF, and replacements made while ON are discarded
litematlist.config.feature_toggles.comme:
When enabled, blocks (building materials) in the schematic are counted into the material list
When disabled, only schematic entity data, container data and entity container data are counted
Toggling immediately refreshes the material list (project folders refresh the merged total list)
If all four parse toggles are disabled, no items are loaded into the material list

When enabled, entities saved in the schematic (minecarts, armor stands, boats, chest boats, etc.) are also counted as items in the material list
Armor worn/held by armor stands (including trim templates and trim materials) is counted along with this toggle
Whether to Count Schematic Entity Containers
litematlist.config.feature_toggles.comme: When enabled together with [Whether to Count Schematic Entities], container contents inside entities (hopper minecarts, chest boats, chested donkeys/llamas, etc.) are counted
